name: coding-bug-fix-resource-leak
description: Bug fix: find and fix a resource leak in cache module

turns.userMessage: In `src/cache.ts`, the `getCached` function opens a file descriptor but never closes it. Find the leak and fix it. Make sure the fd is always released.

mockResponses.text: Fixed the resource leak in `getCached()`: (1) moved fd declaration outside try so it's accessible in finally, (2) added `finally` block that calls `fs.closeSync(fd)` to guarantee the file descriptor is always released, (3) guards against undefined fd in case `openSync` itself throws.
